# Lamdix

> Lamdix is an independent software and AI agency. We design and engineer custom
> software, applied AI systems, and the customer operations that connect them —
> one connected system. Contact: contact@lamdix.com · https://lamdix.com

## Services

- [Custom Software Development](https://lamdix.com/services/custom-software-development): web/mobile apps, SaaS, ecommerce, APIs, enterprise systems, legacy modernization.
- [AI Agents & Chatbots](https://lamdix.com/services/ai-agents-and-chatbots): retrieval-grounded chatbots, tool-using agents, evaluation, human handoff.
- [Voice AI & Calling Agents](https://lamdix.com/services/voice-ai-and-calling-agents): inbound answering, routing, appointments — disclosed, recorded responsibly, human fallback.
- [Calling Campaigns](https://lamdix.com/services/calling-campaigns): lead qualification, appointment setting, customer outreach with consent and opt-outs.
- [Customer Support](https://lamdix.com/services/customer-support): helpdesk, multichannel coverage, AI first-line with human handoff, QA.
- [Cloud & Product Engineering](https://lamdix.com/services/cloud-and-product-engineering): DevOps, cloud, security baseline, testing, UX, integrations, maintenance.
